title: A triple carbon bond
hook: Inspect the bonds and identify the functional group.

knows: Lines in a structural formula represent chemical bonds.
doesNotKnow: An alkyne contains a carbon–carbon triple bond. Ethyne is shown as CH≡CH.

misconception: Every molecule with the same element contains the same functional group.
objective: Recognize the stated functional group from condensed structural connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structure and explanation: Which listed functional group best describes the distinctive group in this condensed structural diagram? This diagram represents ethyne. An alkyne contains a carbon–carbon triple bond. Ethyne is shown as CH≡CH. Lines show bonds; grouped labels such as CH₃ are condensed notation.
The diagram is a condensed 2D structural representation, not a model of molecular geometry.
Recall: Which group is illustrated in the ethyne example? An alkyne contains a carbon–carbon triple bond. Ethyne is shown as CH≡CH.
